slides.sub: Reading the room becomes the skill.

slides.body: The Moon's mahadasha (major planetary period) lasts 10 years in the Vimshottari system, the 120-year dasha cycle. It is a medium arc, not a sprint.
The Moon signifies mind, emotion, care and responsiveness. Think of it as the EQ phase: people-management, empathy and emotional bandwidth matter most.

points: Read the room before you act

slides.body: The Moon's sign, house, strength and your wider chart shape how this feels. Use it as a planning lens, never as a verdict.
